text: Debugging is an important skill for any programmer. When your code does not work as expected, the first step is identifying bugs. You can find them by reading error messages carefully or testing different parts of your program. Many developers use debugging tools, such as breakpoints, to pause the code and check values while it runs. A systematic approach also helps: change one thing at a time and test again. Another useful technique is logging, which means adding print statements to see what the program is doing. With patience and the right methods, you can solve most problems step by step.
